notes.title: Stepping Away Indefinetely
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Alan here.

I’ve recently learned that my cancer has progressed and is now affecting my muscles. I don’t have much time left, and I can’t afford the surgery. Because of that, I’ll be stepping away from all my projects (TGST, RootWorks, ALP, TSP, SSBX, etc.) to take time for myself — to travel and do what I’ve always wanted.

Thanks for everything,
Alan.

now i am going to release it fr

here are some explanation about the new "psycho" graphics mode

every graphic mode (from low to high) uses lumen and partial ray tracing for lightning (lightning bounces, shadows and AO). But, the new graphical modes "epic" and extreme "psycho" uses lumen and FULL RT for lightning. (epic uses full rt but with low quality samples, and psycho uses hq samples for full rt)

here are some images from level 2: 

High (n_frt.png)

And, the lightning is "strange", its yellowish, not that realistic, and with almost no AO at all in the brighter areas.

Psycho (frt.png)

notes.title: News About the Game Release (The Solitude Project)!! (And a Personal Reflection)
notes.notes:
[b]Hello again! I'm here to make an announcement about the game's release! Yes, it's closer than you think. And… sorry for the delay!!! 😃[/b]
[i][b]
I'm currently working on Bedev version 0.77 (Beta - Early Development, though it's not that "early" anymore since it's almost finished!). Here’s everything I’ve added and changed in just one day:[/b][/i]

[olist]
[*] Settings button in the main menu
[*] Reworked the settings menu
[*] Added an explanation for everything in the settings menu!
[*] Reworking the levels, trying to make them longer but not boring!
[*] Improving graphics and textures
[*] Added a new graphics option called "Psycho" (this increases samples for everything—reflections, ray tracing, Lumen, etc.)
[/olist]

[b]Now, about the delay in launching the game:[/b]
[b]I'm really sorry for the delay. I've been through some difficult times. I don’t know if it’s worth mentioning, but here we go…[/b]


[b]I fell into depression again. I couldn't even get out of bed. I spent my days in front of a screen, watching videos that just messed with my mind more and more, and I ended up forgetting about the game. My last real update was last year—the last time I actually added content. My most recent small update was on the 15th.[/b]

[b]I was sexually harassed, threatened, bullied, and almost sexually abused by people I trusted too much. And that’s it. A lot more happened, but Steam's filter probably won’t let me say it.
[/b]
[b]I'm really sorry. The delay is all my fault!! But don’t worry, I plan to release the game this month!! 😃[/b]

notes.title: Announce About Long Support Version / LTS
notes.notes:
[b]What is **LSV**?

LSV (Long Support Version) means it's a Long-Term Support version, meaning a RELEASE version that will stay up for a long time without updates.

So, this is the last game **RELEASE** update, the latest version without bugs.
I'll start uploading Experimental Builds instead of Official Release Builds / Versions. Expect UI, SFX, Visual, and Performance bugs.[/b]
